decisive_items: persistent foreign body sensation in her right eye
A linear, soft-tissue lesion was noted centrally along the lower conjunctival fornix of the right eye
the mass appeared pinkish-yellow rather than the typical salmon pink of lymphoid lesions
response.rationale: Chronic foreign body sensation with a pinkish-yellow conjunctival fornix mass, homogeneous on CT and lacking systemic disease, best fits localized conjunctival amyloidosis; the explicit contrast with salmon-pink lymphoid lesions argues against lymphoma.

rejected.why: The lesion is described as pinkish-yellow rather than the typical salmon pink of lymphoid lesions, making lymphoproliferative disorder less likely.
Granuloma is nonspecific and lacks characteristic imaging or clinical features; the pinkish-yellow chronic fornix mass better fits amyloidosis.
Conjunctival fibroma is a rare nonspecific soft-tissue mass and does not explain the distinctive pinkish-yellow color and chronic foreign body sensation.
